summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands on embedded systems experience across STM32 bare metal C, custom PCB design in EAGLE, and I2C/SPI/UART sensor integration. Background includes firmware on Cortex-M4 microcontrollers, Proteus based hardware verification, and digital signal and image processing work, including a wavelet denoising pipeline that raised PSNR from 65 to 86 on a microscopic surface inspection system. Comfortable across the electrical and software boundary, from schematic level PCB work to Python and Git based development.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture recognition glove integrating an ADXL345 accelerometer, Raspberry Pi, and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate hand motion into HID commands via Python, resolving sensor jitter through custom calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented UART and I2C sensor communication with closed loop feedback.
Led a 25 member robotics team across national competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and firmware integration end to end.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank to suppress low frequency noise in high resolution image stitching, raising PSNR from 65 to 86 through optimized homography and concurrency.
Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis combining image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending real time control commands to an STM32 microcontroller over UART.
Implemented multi servo PWM control with interrupt driven UART commands and manual override logic in embedded C.
Used FreeRTOS with mutex protected task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in bare metal embedded C with timer synchronized sensing and real time display.
Implemented timer triggered ADC conversions, interrupt driven sampling, and a low level I2C driver against GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, and I2C1 registers.
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash and 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two link inverse kinematics in C++ on Arduino, driving five servos with range gated contact detection via a TCA9548A I2C sensor multiplexer and closed loop feedback.
